model: 3500 W Super Quiet Inverter Generator (Harbor Freight item 59137)

gaps: The parts list has no OEM part numbers and no per-part ratings.
The parts list prints quantity 8 for 'Motor Stator' (item 174) against quantity 1 for 'Motor Rotor' (item 181), so no quantity is given for the stator here.
The 12 VDC outlet is not put on the inverter because the manual doesn't say what feeds it.
The spec table also names a CR2032 3 V coin cell but the manual does not say what it powers, so it is left out.
A 'Step Motor Mounting Bracket' (item 26) is listed but the step motor itself is not, so no throttle stepper is claimed.
method: Single source: Harbor Freight owner's manual for item 59137 (copyright 2022, manual code 24k); spec table on page 2, controls on pages 9-10 and 14-16, parts list on pages 25-26.
The parts list gives reference numbers, names and quantities only.
The inverter figures are the generator's rated output from the spec table.
'Motor' in this list is read as the generator's stator and rotor, not a drive motor (the starter is a separate item, 142).
The 12 VDC outlet (8 A nominal, not regulated, per the manual).

comps.spec: Engine Assembly (parts list item 106, qty 1): 212 cc horizontal single-cylinder 4-stroke OHV, forced-air cooled, bore x stroke 70 x 55 mm, compression 9.0:1, 2600-3600 rpm; spark plug F7RTC (Torch) or equivalent
Listed as 'Motor Stator' (item 174) and 'Motor Rotor' (item 181, qty 1), with a 'Motor Fan' (item 71)

Inverter Assembly (item 103, qty 1), with an inverter mounting bracket (item 107) and inverter inlet air deflector (item 98); the spec table rates the generator's AC output at 120 VAC 60 Hz single phase, 25 A, rated 3000 W running (3500 starting watts maximum)
Storage Battery (item 104, qty 1): 12 VDC battery supplied for the electric start, reached through the battery access door
Carbon Monoxide Sensor (item 68) for the CO shutoff, with a CO sensor light on the control panel
Oil Level Sensor (item 55); the control panel has a Low Oil indicator
Ignition Coil Assembly (item 63); fires a Spark Plug (item 10), type F7RTC (Torch), gap 0.027-0.031 in
Starting Motor Components (item 142) for the electric start
Overcurrent Protectors (items 82, 83 and 196, qty 1 each); the control panel has two 120 VAC breaker reset buttons and a 12 VDC breaker reset button beside the DC outlet
Multifunctional Indicating Meter (item 89); the control panel has a digital display screen that cycles through voltage, amperage, VA and run hours
Fuel Tank (item 166), 2.64 gal / 10.00 L, 87+ octane unleaded
